title: Build JakeAI Release & Promotion Engine
purpose: Create a fail-closed, non-executing release and promotion planner that binds promotion approval to an exact production-candidate fingerprint, exact builder head, required review lanes, explicit human approval, and a pre-recorded rollback reference.
unresolved_conditions: Exact candidate must pass all inherited baseline gates plus Release and Promotion tests before baseline promotion.
The engine must remain non-executing: no merge, deployment, publication, checkout activation, or commercial activation occurs from the planning gate.
Any future production promotion requires a separate exact-candidate approval request and explicit human authorization.
evidence: Default promotion request is fail-closed with all authorization fields false.
Rollback reference is recorded before any future release authorization can be considered.
